process_description: CANONICAL health check endpoint for the document delivery module. CANONICAL serve the tenant document delivery inbox page. Returns HTML. CANONICAL send a document from a professional to a tenant. Creates a delivery record. CANONICAL get the tenant's delivery inbox. Returns all deliveries sent to the tenant. CANONICAL get the professional's delivery outbox. Returns all deliveries sent by the professional. CANONICAL get a specific delivery by ID. Returns full delivery details including document. CANONICAL mark a delivery as viewed. Updates the read receipt for the delivery. CANONICAL sign a delivered document. Tenant applies a signature to the document. CANONICAL reject a delivered document. Tenant provides a reason for rejection.
